Card Q&A.q: Does this card's effect delete all of my Digimon and Tamers, too?

Effect: [Main] You may return 1 of your Digimon with [Omnimon] in its name to its owner's hand to delete all Digimon and Tamers. Trash all of the digivolution cards of the Digimon you returned with this effect.
Security Effect: [Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.
